verdict.rationale: Docs show PlanetScale supports restoring a branch to an earlier state via backups and Postgres point-in-time restore (--restore-point), and backups can be scheduled/restored for branches without needing a dump. However, there is no explicit documentation of a 'reset branch from parent' command/feature that resyncs a branch's schema/data to match its parent branch. missing for 10: explicit reset-to-parent capability, independent/hands-on confirmation of restore workflow, MySQL/Vitess-side point-in-time restore parity.
